title: dWolves
description: A simple plugin to allow your friends to also access your wolves!
body:
**dWolves is a wolf trust system built for the Doughmination network!**
It lets players grant trusted friends access to their wolves — so pack mates can move, manage, and care for wolves in a shared base without the owner needing to be online.

**Highlights include:**
- 🐺 **Trust system** — grant Basic or Full trust to players for all your wolves
- 🪑 **Sit / Stand** — trusted players can toggle wolf positions freely
- 📍 **Teleport** — pull trusted wolves to your location with a single command
- ✏️ **Rename** — Full trust players can rename wolves via name tag
- 🍖 **Feeding** — trusted players can heal and care for wolves
- 🔒 **Smart ownership** — wolves temporarily follow trusted players when the owner is offline, and instantly revert when they log back in

**Installation is simple** — drop it into your server's `plugins` folder, restart, and players can start trusting each other straight away with no admin configuration needed.

> ⚠️ Requires Paper 1.21.1+

*Built for [Doughmination](https://modding.doughmination.win)*
